#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 1000000007;
const long long INF = (long long) 1e18 + 1;

long long nCr[100][100];

long long f(long long p, int a, int b, int c, int d) {
    p *= nCr[a][b];
    p %= MOD;
    p *= nCr[c][d];
    p %= MOD;
    return p;
}

struct Tuple {
    long long d;
    int x, y, z;
    Tuple() {}
    Tuple(long long d, int x, int y, int z) : d(d), x(x), y(y), z(z) {}
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n, K;
    cin >> n >> K;
    
    int cnt1 = 0, cnt2 = 0;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
            if (j == 0 || j == i)
                nCr[i][j] = 1;
            else
                nCr[i][j] = (nCr[i-1][j] + nCr[i-1][j-1]) % MOD;
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        if (x == 50)
            cnt1++;
        else
            cnt2++;
    }
    
    long long dist[200][200][2];
    long long dp[200][200][2];
    
    for (int i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 200; j++) {
            dist[i][j][0] = dist[i][j][1] = INF;
            dp[i][j][0] = dp[i][j][1] = 0;
        }
    }
    
    dist[0][0][0] = 0;
    dp[0][0][0] = 1;
    
    queue<Tuple> pq;
    pq.push(Tuple(0, 0, 0, 0));
    
    while (!pq.empty()) {
        Tuple curr = pq.front();
        pq.pop();
        int x = curr.x;
        int y = curr.y;
        int z = curr.z;
        long long d = dist[x][y][z];
        
        if (z == 0) {
            int rem_x = cnt1 - x;
            int rem_y = cnt2 - y;
            for (int i = 0; i <= rem_x; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= rem_y; j++) {
                    if (i == 0 && j == 0) continue;
                    if (i * 50 + j * 100 > K) break;
                    if (dist[x + i][y + j][z ^ 1] >= d + 1) {
                        if (dist[x + i][y + j][z ^ 1] > d + 1) {
                            dist[x + i][y + j][z ^ 1] = d + 1;
                            pq.push(Tuple(dist[x + i][y + j][z ^ 1], x + i, y + j, z ^ 1));
                            dp[x + i][y + j][z ^ 1] = (dp[x + i][y + j][z ^ 1] + f(dp[x][y][z], rem_x, i, rem_y, j)) % MOD;
                        } else {
                            dp[x + i][y + j][z ^ 1] = (dp[x + i][y + j][z ^ 1] + f(dp[x][y][z], rem_x, i, rem_y, j)) % MOD;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            int rem_x = x;
            int rem_y = y;
            for (int i = 0; i <= rem_x; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= rem_y; j++) {
                    if (i == 0 && j == 0) continue;
                    if (i * 50 + j * 100 > K) break;
                    if (dist[x - i][y - j][z ^ 1] >= d + 1) {
                        if (dist[x - i][y - j][z ^ 1] > d + 1) {
                            dist[x - i][y - j][z ^ 1] = d + 1;
                            pq.push(Tuple(dist[x - i][y - j][z ^ 1], x - i, y - j, z ^ 1));
                            dp[x - i][y - j][z ^ 1] = (dp[x - i][y - j][z ^ 1] + f(dp[x][y][z], rem_x, i, rem_y, j)) % MOD;
                        } else {
                            dp[x - i][y - j][z ^ 1] = (dp[x - i][y - j][z ^ 1] + f(dp[x][y][z], rem_x, i, rem_y, j)) % MOD;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    if (dist[cnt1][cnt2][1] == INF)
        cout << -1 << '\n';
    else
        cout << dist[cnt1][cnt2][1] << '\n';
    cout << dp[cnt1][cnt2][1] << '\n';
    
    return 0;
}
